selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 在目标位置召唤一个图腾，从周围的空气中聚集电能，在2秒之后爆炸，使周围8码内的敌人昏迷3秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Summons a totem at the target location that gathers electrical energy from the surrounding air and explodes after 2 sec, stunning all enemies within 8 yards for 3 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 当变形为幽魂之狼形态时，每过1秒，你的移动速度就会提高5%，伤害减免提高5%，最多叠加4次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: While transformed into a Ghost Wolf, you gain 5% increased movement speed and 5% damage reduction every 1 sec, stacking up to 4 times.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
耐力提高8%。

当你的生命值全满时，复生的冷却速度提高50%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Stamina increased by 8%.

While you are at full health, Reincarnation cools down 50% faster.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 向敌人投掷一发闪电箭，造成([116.4% of Spell Power])点自然伤害，然后跃向附近的其他敌人。总共影响3个目标。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Hurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing (116.4% of Spell Power) Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies. Affects 3 total targets

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 召唤一个巨型土元素保护你和你的盟友，产生大量威胁值并周期性嘲讽敌人，持续30秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Calls forth a Greater Earth Elemental to protect you and your allies, generating high threat and taunting enemies periodically for 30 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 受到的所有魔法伤害降低8%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces all magic damage taken by 8%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 为友方目标恢复([231% of Spell Power])点生命值，然后跳跃到最多20码范围内受伤最重的3名盟友进行治疗。治疗效果每跳一次就会降低30%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Heals the friendly target for (231% of Spell Power), then jumps up to 20 yards to heal the 3 most injured nearby allies. Healing is reduced by 30% with each jump.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 移除所有的移动限制效果，并使你的移动速度提高60%，持续8秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Removes all movement impairing effects and increases your movement speed by 60% for 8 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
元素,  增强
大地之盾不再消耗充能，且拥有 115%的效能。

 恢复
大地之盾和水之护盾不再消耗充能，且拥有 115%的效能。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Restoration
Earth Shield and Water Shield no longer lose charges and are 115% effective.

 Elemental,  Enhancement
Earth Shield no longer loses charges and is 115% effective.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
用大地之盾保护目标，使你对其造成的治疗效果提高20%，在其受到伤害时为其恢复[([73% of Spell Power]) * (1.2)]点生命值。这个治疗效果每3秒只能触发一次。最多拥有9层充能。

 [元素环绕: 同一时间只能在萨满祭司以及另一个目标身上施放大地之盾。萨满祭司最多可激活两种元素护盾。 / 同一时间只能在一个目标身上施放大地之盾。萨满祭司在同一时间只能激活一种元素护盾。]
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Protects the target with an earthen shield, increasing your healing on them by 20% and healing them for [(73% of Spell Power) * (1.2)] when they take damage. This heal can only occur once every 3 sec. Maximum 9 charges.

 [Elemental Orbit: Earth Shield can only be placed on the Shaman and one other target at a time. The Shaman can have up to two Elemental Shields active on them / Earth Shield can only be placed on one target at a time. Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman.]

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 在你脚下召唤一个图腾，持续10秒。该图腾会震动附近的地面，移除30码范围内所有小队和团队成员的恐惧、魅惑和睡眠效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Summons a totem at your feet that shakes the ground around it for 10 sec, removing Fear, Charm and Sleep effects from party and raid members within 30 yards.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
你身上可激活的元素护盾种类提高1种。

你可以在自己和一名盟友身上同时拥有大地之盾。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Increases the number of Elemental Shields you can have active on yourself by 1.

You can have Earth Shield on yourself and one ally at the same time.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你造成的所有火焰和冰霜伤害提高3%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases all Fire and Frost damage you deal by 3%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
恢复
你的武器和盾牌灌魔效果提高20%。

 元素
你的武器和盾牌灌魔效果提高30%。

 增强
你的武器灌魔效果提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Restoration
The effects of your weapon and shield imbues are increased by 20%.

 Elemental
The effects of your weapon and shield imbues are increased by 30%.

 Enhancement
The effects of your weapon imbues are increased by 15%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 狂风图腾的移动速度加成提高10%，现在会移除诱捕效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Wind Rush Totem's movement speed bonus is increased by 10% and now removes snares.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 移除一个友方目标身上所有诅咒效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Removes all Curse effects from a friendly target.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 星界转移的冷却时间缩短30秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the cooldown of Astral Shift by 30 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的土元素不再嘲讽附近敌人或产生威胁值，而是在激活时使你的最大生命值提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your Earth Elemental no longer taunts nearby enemies or generates threat and instead increases your maximum health by 15% while active.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 当你的生命值降低到35%以下时，立即为你恢复40%的最大生命值。每45秒最多触发一次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: When your health is brought below 35%, you instantly heal for 40% of your maximum health. Cannot occur more than once every 45 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的移动速度提高5%，并且幽魂之狼的移动速度额外提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases your movement speed by 5% and the movement speed bonus of Ghost Wolf by an additional 5%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
元素,  增强,  恢复
以强风冲击干扰目标的专注，打断施法并使其在4秒内无法施放该系的法术。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Elemental,  Enhancement,  Restoration
Disrupts the target's concentration with a burst of wind, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 将部分身体移入元素位面，使受到的伤害降低40%，持续12秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Shift partially into the elemental planes, taking 40% less damage for 12 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的自然法术和技能的爆击几率提高2%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the critical strike chance of your Nature spells and abilities by 2%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 电能图腾的冷却时间缩短15秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the cooldown of Capacitor Totem by 15 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 净化敌方目标，移除1个有益魔法效果。[成功净化一个目标后会获得一层漩涡武器。]
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Purges the enemy target, removing 1 beneficial Magic effect.[Successfully purging a target grants a stack of Maelstrom Weapon.]

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 在目标位置召唤一个图腾，持续15秒，使经过图腾附近10码范围内的盟友移动速度提高40%，持续5秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Summons a totem at the target location for 15 sec, continually granting all allies who pass within 10 yards 40% increased movement speed for 5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使用风剪打断法术时，受到的所有法术伤害降低15%，持续12秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Interrupting a spell with Wind Shear reduces all spell damage taken by 15% for 12 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
恢复
水之护盾使你的智力提高3%。

施放水之护盾现在会施加你的武器灌注。如果你拥有元素环绕天赋，还会施加大地之盾。

 增强
闪电之盾使你的敏捷提高3%。

施放闪电之盾现在会施加你的武器灌注。如果你拥有元素环绕天赋，还会施加大地之盾。

 元素
闪电之盾使你的智力提高3%。

施放闪电之盾现在会施加你的武器灌注。如果你拥有元素环绕天赋，还会施加大地之盾。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Enhancement
Lightning Shield increases your Agility by 3%.

Casting Lightning Shield now applies your weapon imbuements. Earth Shield is also applied if you have the Elemental Orbit talent.

 Elemental
Lightning Shield increases your Intellect by 3%.

Casting Lightning Shield now applies your weapon imbuements. Earth Shield is also applied if you have the Elemental Orbit talent.

 Restoration
Water Shield increases your Intellect by 3%.

Casting Water Shield now applies your weapon imbuements. Earth Shield is also applied if you have the Elemental Orbit talent.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 大部分图腾的冷却时间缩短5秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the cooldown of most totems by 5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
你将熔岩的能量注入到副手武器中，燃烧目标，造成([238.717% of Attack Power])点火焰伤害。

如果你的副手武器已经受到火舌武器影响，伤害提高100%。 [熔火突袭: 熔岩猛击会使你目标身上的烈焰震击扩散到附近0个目标身上。] [鞭笞烈焰: 熔岩猛击使烈焰震击对目标的伤害提高100%，持续20秒。]
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Charges your off-hand weapon with lava and burns your target, dealing (238.717% of Attack Power) Fire damage.

Damage is increased by 100% if your offhand weapon is imbued with Flametongue Weapon. [Molten Assault: Lava Lash will spread Flame Shock from your target to 0 nearby targets] [Lashing Flames: Lava Lash increases the damage of Flame Shock on its target by 100% for 20 sec]

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 精通提高3%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Mastery increased by 3%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 在你的法术或技能爆击后，使你下3次近战攻击的攻击速度提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases your attack speed by 15% for your next 3 melee swings after dealing a critical strike with a spell or ability.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 闪电箭和闪电链最多可消耗10层漩涡武器。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning can consume up to 10 Maelstrom Weapon stacks.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
漩涡武器现在可以额外叠加5次。

每消耗一层漩涡武器会使你获得溢流漩涡，使下一个治疗之涌或治疗链的施法时间缩短10%，治疗效果提高10%，最多叠加10次。此效果最多可累积20次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Maelstrom Weapon can now stack 5 additional times.

Each Maelstrom Weapon stacks consumed grants Overflowing Maelstrom, reducing the cast time of your next Healing Surge or Chain Heal by 10%, and increasing their healing by 10% up to 10 times. This effect can be accumulated up to 20 times.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
当你用近战武器造成伤害时，有一定几率生成一层漩涡武器，至多可叠加5层。

每层漩涡武器会使你的下一个闪电箭或闪电链的施法时间缩短20%，造成的伤害提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
When you deal damage with a melee weapon, you have a chance to generate Maelstrom Weapon, stacking up to 5 times. 

Each stack of Maelstrom Weapon reduces the cast time of your next Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning by 20% and increases its damage by 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
增强
为你的武器注入火元素的力量，持续1小时，你的每次攻击都会额外造成([3.96% of Attack Power])点火焰伤害。

 元素
为你的武器注入火元素的力量，持续1小时，并使你的火焰法术伤害提高5.0%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Enhancement
Imbue your weapon with the element of Fire for 1 hour, causing each of your attacks to deal (3.96% of Attack Power) additional Fire damage.

 Elemental
Imbue your weapon with the element of Fire for 1 hour, increasing the damage of your Fire spells by 5.0%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 熔岩猛击的冷却时间缩短6.0秒，而且对受你烈焰震击影响的目标使用熔岩猛击时，烈焰震击将扩散至附近最多5个敌人身上。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Lava Lash cooldown reduced by 6.0 sec, and if Lava Lash is used against a target affected by your Flame Shock, Flame Shock will be spread to up to 5 nearby enemies.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的自然法术的爆击伤害提高，数值相当于你的爆击几率的40%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: The critical strike damage of your Nature abilities are increased by 40% of your critical strike chance.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
毁灭之风和根深蒂固元素的持续时间延长2秒，并且升腾的冷却时间缩短60秒。

在毁灭之风或升腾持续期间，风暴打击和毁灭闪电会消耗最多10层漩涡武器，向你的敌人释放一次100%效果的闪电箭或闪电链，取决于你最近使用的技能。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Doom Winds and Deeply Rooted Elements last 2 sec longer, and the cooldown of Ascendance is reduced by 60 sec.

During Doom Winds or Ascendance, Stormstrike and Crash Lightning consume up to 10 Maelstrom Weapon to discharge a Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning at 100% effectiveness at your enemy, whichever you most recently used.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 当毁灭之风或升腾效果激活时，每1秒产生1层漩涡武器。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: During Doom Winds or Ascendance, you generate 1 Maelstrom Weapon stack every 1 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 风暴打击的伤害提高20%。风暴打击和熔岩猛击有100%的几率产生1层漩涡武器。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Stormstrike damage is increased by 20%, and Stormstrike and Lava Lash have a 100% chance to generate 1 stack of Maelstrom Weapon.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 每一种激活的武器灌魔使造成的所有火焰、冰霜和自然伤害提高5.0%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Each active weapon imbue increases all Fire, Frost, and Nature damage dealt by 5.0%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
元素
立即用炽焰雷霆震击目标及10码内的5个敌人，施加烈焰震击并造成([400% of Spell Power])点自然伤害，且必定爆击。

产生1层漩涡武器。

 增强
立即用炽焰雷霆震击目标及10码内的5个敌人，施加烈焰震击并造成([400% of Spell Power])点自然伤害，且必定爆击。

产生1层漩涡武器。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Elemental
Instantly shocks the target and 5 enemies within 10 yds with blazing thunder, applying Flame Shock and dealing (400% of Spell Power) Nature damage. Always critically strikes.

Generates 1 stack of Maelstrom Weapon.

 Enhancement
Instantly shocks the target and 5 enemies within 10 yds with blazing thunder, applying Flame Shock and dealing (400% of Spell Power) Nature damage. Always critically strikes.

Generates 1 stack of Maelstrom Weapon.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 将风元素灌注进你的主手武器之中，持续1小时。每次主手武器攻击都有15%的几率触发 [不羁之风: 三次 / 两次]额外攻击，每次造成([27.945% of Attack Power])%点物理伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Imbue your main-hand weapon with the element of Wind for 1 hour. Each main-hand attack has a 15% chance to trigger [Unruly Winds: three / two] extra attacks, dealing (27.945% of Attack Power)% Physical damage each.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
在你周围释放一场毁灭性的风暴，每1秒对附近敌人造成([120% of Attack Power])点风暴打击伤害，持续8秒。

你触发风怒武器的几率提高50%，风怒武器的伤害提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Unleash a devastating storm around yourself, dealing (120% of Attack Power) Stormstrike damage every 1 sec to nearby enemies for 8 sec.

Increases your chance to activate Windfury Weapon by 50%, and the damage of Windfury Weapon by 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
风暴打击额外获得一次使用次数。

风暴喷涌还会使你的下一个风暴打击额外造成25%的自然伤害，最多叠加2次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Stormstrike has an additional charge.

Stormsurge now also causes your next Stormstrike to deal 25% additional damage as Nature damage, stacking up to 2 times.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
元素伤害提高10%。

每消耗一层漩涡武器，可使风暴打击的冷却时间缩短0.3秒，熔岩猛击的冷却时间缩短0.3秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Elemental damage increased by 10%. 

Each stack of Maelstrom Weapon consumed reduces the cooldown of Stormstrike by 0.3 sec and Lava Lash by 0.3 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 风暴打击和熔岩猛击会释放一道100%效果的闪电链，每次跳跃伤害降低20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Stormstrike and Lava Lash unleash a Chain Lightning at 100% effectiveness that deals 20% reduced damage with each jump.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 精通：增强元素触发风怒和风暴喷涌的几率提高150%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increase the chance for Mastery: Enhanced Elements to trigger Windfury and Stormsurge by 150%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 风怒武器有100%的几率触发第三次攻击。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Windfury Weapon has a 100% chance to trigger a third attack.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 风怒触发几率额外提高10%，伤害提高50%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Windfury has a 10% additional chance to trigger and its damage is increased by 50%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的毁灭闪电每击中一个目标，都会使你下一个风暴打击的伤害提高25%，最多叠加6层。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Each target hit by Crash Lightning increases the damage of your next Stormstrike by 25%, up to a maximum of 6 stacks.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
对前方所有敌人施放电击，造成([183.617% of Attack Power])点自然伤害。

你的武器将受到强化，持续12秒，使风暴打击和熔岩猛击还能造成([97.7592% of Attack Power])点自然伤害，由你前方最多5个目标平均分摊。 [风暴释放: 多次施加可以叠加。]
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Electrocutes all enemies in front of you, dealing (183.617% of Attack Power) Nature damage. 

Enhances your weapons for 12 sec, causing Stormstrike and Lava Lash to discharge (97.7592% of Attack Power) Nature damage split between up to 5 enemies in front of you. [Storm Unleashed: Multiple applications may overlap]

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
转化成空气升腾者形态，持续15秒并施放毁灭之风，使风暴打击的冷却时间和消耗降低60%，并将自动攻击和风暴打击变成风切，无视护甲，攻击距离为30码。

未激活升腾效果时，消耗漩涡武器的技能每消耗一层漩涡武器，就有0.5%的几率施放毁灭之风。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Transform into an Air Ascendant for 15 sec and unleash Doom Winds, reducing the cooldown and cost of Stormstrike by 60%, and transforming your auto attack and Stormstrike into Wind attacks which bypass armor and have a 30 yd range.

Maelstrom Weapon spenders have a 0.5% chance to unleash Doom Winds per Maelstrom Weapon spent while Ascendance is not active.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
元素
消耗的每点漩涡值额外有0.30%的几率将你的下一个闪电箭升级为狂风怒号。

 增强
风暴打击有较小几率将你的下一个闪电箭升级为狂风怒号。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Elemental
Each Maelstrom spent has an additional 0.30% chance to upgrade your next Lightning Bolt to Tempest.

 Enhancement
Stormstrike has a small chance to upgrade your next Lightning Bolt to Tempest.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
元素
引雷针的目标还会受到狂风怒号所造成伤害的10%，并且狂风怒号会施加引雷针效果。

 增强
获得引雷针天赋：
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Enhancement
Gain the effects of the Lightning Rod talent:

subSpellsCn.name: 引雷针
subSpellsCn.description:
[狂风怒号: 狂风怒号、] [ 元素: 大地震击、元素冲击和地震术 / 闪电箭和闪电链]使目标变成引雷针，持续8秒。
 
你的 [狂风怒号: 狂风怒号、闪电箭 / 闪电箭]和闪电链造成伤害时，引雷针会承受总伤害量的8%。

subSpellsEn.name: Lightning Rod
subSpellsEn.description:
[Tempest: Tempest] [ Elemental: Earth Shock, Elemental Blast, and Earthquake / Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning] make your target a Lightning Rod for 8 sec.
 
Lightning Rods take 8% of all damage you deal with [Tempest: Tempest, Lightning Bolt / Lightning Bolt] and Chain Lightning.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
元素
地震术和闪电链的伤害提高5%。

 增强
毁灭闪电和闪电链的伤害提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Enhancement
Crash Lightning and Chain Lightning damage increased by 20%.

 Elemental
Earthquake and Chain Lightning damage increased by 5%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 闪电之盾使你受到的伤害降低3%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Lightning Shield reduces the damage you take by 3%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
元素
施放狂风怒号会获得一层风暴守护者。

 增强
狂风怒号使你的下一个闪电链变为瞬发，造成的伤害提高40%，并额外施放一次。

可以积累最多2层。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Elemental
Casting Tempest grants a charge of Stormkeeper.

 Enhancement
Tempest causes your next Chain Lightning to be instant cast, deal 40% increased damage, and cast an additional time.

Can accumulate up to 2 charges.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
元素
消耗漩涡值使你获得1%急速，持续15秒。

多次施加可以重叠生效。

 增强
消耗漩涡武器层数使你获得1%急速，持续15秒。

多次施加可以重叠生效。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Enhancement
Spending Maelstrom Weapon stacks grants you 1% haste for 15 sec.
